- log entries: 603 (ok=598, not-ok=5)

## Coverage

- median rows/ticker: 5777
- short-span flags (rows < 94% of weekdays in span): 1

## Known data artifacts (documented, not fixed)

- zero-volume days: 19186 across the universe, 63% before 2008 (Yahoo's pre-2008 volume gap; affects relative-volume legs by epoch, see data/README.md)
- largest adjusted-OHLC inconsistency: $53.74 (Yahoo special-dividend artifact; distorts High/Low features on isolated days, not Close-based returns)
